subject: FinArc + Redwood — discovery recap and next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@finarc.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-14T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: FinArc + Redwood — Discovery recap & next steps

Hi Alex — thanks again for the 30-minute intro today. Quick recap of what we heard and proposed next steps: 

- Priority pain: production inference cost and unpredictable tail latency for middle‑weight models (~2–4B).
- Constraints: customer data must remain in our VPC, SOC2 evidence required, procurement window ~Oct-Nov.
- Success metric: reduce per‑token cost by 30% while keeping 95th percentile latency <200ms for interactive requests.

What we promised to send: the Discovery Deck (attached), a short checklist for security/compliance evidence, and a suggested 6‑week pilot plan.

Proposed immediate next steps (pick one):
1) Technical deep dive (30–45m) with your infra lead — we’ll bring a runtime engineer to demo latency/caching behavior.
2) Procurement sync to align on SOW and timelines (if procurement is the blocker).

If you share a couple of times next week I’ll lock something in. I’ve attached the FinArc-Discovery-Deck.pdf — it has the pilot outline and sample economics.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee

Date: 2026-08-20T13:00:00-07:00
Subject: FW: FinArc — next play / proposal

Marcus / Avery — forwarding the thread with Alex (discovery earlier this week). Quick notes and proposed cadence: 

- Account signals: clear cost problem, SOC2+VPC constraint, procurement horizon Oct-Nov.
- Risk: low responsiveness and competing internal projects at FinArc (analytics rewrite).

Proposed plays (ranked):
1) Offer a 6-week pilot with dedicated infra, discounted pilot pricing, and a short SOC2 evidence packet — emphasize fast time-to-value.
2) If procurement is the blocker, offer to joint-call with their procurement lead and hand them a pre-populated SOW to speed legal review. (Attached: SOW-template.docx)
3) If they don’t respond after the above, do a low-effort nurture campaign and revisit in Q1.

Can CS commit one solutions engineer for the deep dive? If yes, I’ll send the calendar invite and slide the pilot economics we discussed.

Thanks — Soojin

Attachments: SOW-template.docx

Either way, a one‑line reply is fine. Thanks for the time so far — and happy to re-open when it’s right.
